primary_goal: Compare added lateral, phase and pore-pressure processes under stated shared inputs; never rank by closeness to unaccepted event arrival

outcome_roles.local_observational: data/product/geographic support only; no accepted event trajectory
outcome_roles.conditional_scenario: regional computed propagation under prescribed source and material parameters
outcome_roles.external_transfer: literature constraints and model-specific material assumptions
outcome_roles.numerical_benchmark: synthetic and official reference examples; not event validation

derived_metrics: arrival time with temporal bracket or output interval
wall-clock cost and actual completed horizon
ranking_dimensions: incremental information relative to terrain/parameter uncertainty
not_scored: number of snapshots as independent events
noncomparable_parameters: D-Claw porosity/effective stress and multiphase phase drag have no automatic one-to-one Voellmy mapping; report NA or controlled within-framework ablation.
statistical_weights: none assigned to parameter grid; report conditional ranges, never automatic95pct interval
